s:
Identify the correct statements about the Prime Minister's Development Initiative for North East Region (PM-DevINE).

I. It was announced in the Union Budget 2022-23 to address developmental gaps in the North Eastern Region (NER).

II. PM-DevINE is an addition to the quantum of resources available for the development of the North Eastern Region and will not be a substitute for existing Central and State Schemes.

III. It enables livelihood activities for the youth and women of North Eastern Region.

IV. PM-DevINE will fund infrastructure convergently, in the spirit of PM Gati Shakti.
x: PM-DevINE was announced in Budget 2022-23. It adds to the resources for the North East (it does not substitute for other schemes), supports livelihood activities for youth and women, and funds infrastructure in the spirit of PM Gati Shakti, so all four statements are correct.

src: APPSC Junior Lecturers General Studies & Mental Ability 2020

src: APPSC Polytechnic Colleges Lecturers (Engineering & Non-Engi

src: APPSC Sample Taker General Studies & Mental Abilities 2023
s:

x: The May 2025 insurance model (Health Minister Y. Satya Kumar Yadav) covers up to Rs 25 lakh per family a year for about 1.65 crore poor and middle-class families under NTR Vaidya Seva.

src: APPSC 2023 Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspectors
s:
Which of following statements are correct about Aarogyasri - Universal Healthcare scheme of the Andhra Pradesh government?
a) YSR Aarogyasri cover is for all categories with annual income less than ₹10 lakh.
b) Aarogyasri is applicable for all medical expenses above ₹5,000.
c) Aarogyasri treatment is applicable throughout the country.
d) ₹10,000 pension per month to be provided to the persons suffering from kidney, thalassemia and perineal diseases.
x:
Most keys: c and d. Strictly, c is loose: Aarogyasri reaches only empanelled hospitals in Hyderabad, Chennai and Bengaluru, not the whole country; APPSC later ignored this question for a question/answer discrepancy.
c and d is the intended answer: Aarogyasri treatment extends to empanelled hospitals in Hyderabad, Chennai and Bengaluru, and patients of kidney disease, thalassaemia etc. get a Rs 10,000 monthly pension. a is wrong (income limit Rs 5 lakh, not Rs 10 lakh) and b is wrong (applies to treatment costing Rs 1,000 or more, not Rs 5,000).

src: APPSC 2023 Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspectors
s:
Which of following statements are correct about Aarogyasri - Universal Healthcare scheme of the Andhra Pradesh government?
a) YSR Aarogyasri cover is for all categories with annual income less than ₹10 lakh.
b) Aarogyasri is applicable for all medical expenses above ₹5,000.
c) Aarogyasri treatment is applicable throughout the country.
d) ₹10,000 pension per month to be provided to the persons suffering from kidney, thalassemia and perineal diseases. Note: For this question, discrepancy is found in question/answer. So,this question is ignored for all candidates.
x:
APPSC's final key ignored this question (discrepancy in question/answer). The intended answer is c and d, but c is loose: coverage is in Hyderabad, Chennai and Bengaluru, not 'throughout the country'.
c and d is the intended answer: treatment reaches empanelled hospitals in Hyderabad, Chennai and Bengaluru, and kidney/thalassaemia patients get Rs 10,000 a month. a is wrong (income limit Rs 5 lakh) and b is wrong (treatment costing Rs 1,000 or more).

Answer given (Testbook, APPSC Group-II 2019): Welfare Corporations. Strictly the portal also links the federations and banks; only scholarships (Jnanabhumi) is clearly outside it.
